record.text:
Things I'm watching on the foldable iPhone:

• The hinge mechanism

• How the software handles the transition between phone and tablet modes

• Where on the iPhone/iPad continuum the unfolded UI falls

• The presence or absence of MagSafe and FaceID

• Cameras

• Price and branding

Only thing I'm interested in is if they announce anything other than phones. The foldable iPhone I still only see maybe a small market for, and even smaller with the rumored pricing. I think the only thing I'd be looking forward to is seeing a new Apple TV release, nothing else of interest to me.
